title: Experiment 001 Run 4 frozen corpus snapshot
content_note: Metadata only. This file contains no publisher text, titles, summaries, URLs or feed entries.

snapshot.path_convention: data/snapshots/<experiment>-run<N>.sqlite3: a local, untracked, read-only copy of an experiment database frozen after run N

creation.method: Byte-for-byte file copy (Python shutil.copyfile) of the live database; SQLite was not used to open or write either file during the copy.
preconditions_confirmed: No collector or Python process running
No SQLite -journal, -wal or -shm sidecar beside the live database
Live database SHA-256 equal to the gold corpus hash before copying
Live counts 6 sources / 4 runs / 24 fetches / 177 articles / 620 sightings / 0 entry errors (read with mode=ro&immutable=1)
creation.post_copy: Snapshot marked read-only with the Windows read-only attribute (attrib +R).

run4_boundary.definition: finished_at of run 4, the last completed run; no collection timestamp in the snapshot is later than this.

gold_encoding.relationship: The gold file's corpus.sha256_at_encoding equals this snapshot's SHA-256, so this snapshot is the exact database its article IDs refer to. The gold file was not modified when the snapshot was made.

validation.access_mode: All SQLite access to the snapshot used URI mode=ro&immutable=1.
validation.ATLAS_GOLD_CHECK_DB_test: tests.test_event_relationship_gold OptionalDatabaseTextTests passed against the snapshot
validation.offline_test_suite: 303 tests passed with the project virtual environment (1 skipped without ATLAS_GOLD_CHECK_DB; 0 skipped with it set to the snapshot)

rights_and_reproducibility.untracked_by_design: The SQLite snapshot is intentionally not tracked by Git because it contains stored publisher and feed evidence (titles, summaries, raw feed entries).
rights_and_reproducibility.not_independently_reproducible: This manifest identifies the snapshot but does not make the corpus reproducible without possession of the snapshot file. Feeds change over time, so re-running collection would not recreate it.
rights_and_reproducibility.loss_consequence: Losing the snapshot means losing the exact Run 4 evidence that the gold encoding's article IDs refer to.
rights_and_reproducibility.backup: A future private backup of the snapshot may be appropriate; it is outside the scope of this freeze and has not been made.
rights_and_reproducibility.verification: Anyone holding a candidate copy can confirm its identity by comparing its SHA-256 with snapshot.sha256.
